steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace
echo "---"
ls -la /workspace/logs 2>/dev/null || ls -la /app/logs 2>/dev/null
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
head -n 8 /workspace/logs/2025-08-12_api.log
echo "=== other formats ==="
head -n 4 /workspace/logs/2025-08-12_db.log
head -n 4 /workspace/logs/2025-08-12_app.log
head -n 4 /workspace/logs/2025-08-12_auth.log
echo "=== sample distinct patterns ==="
head -n 20 /workspace/logs/2025-08-12_api.log | cat -A | head -n 20
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
echo "=== bracket tokens distribution ==="
grep -hoE '\[[A-Z]+\]' logs/*.log | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== lines without bracket severity ==="
grep -hvE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG)\]' logs/*.log | head -n 10
echo "count no-bracket:"
grep -hvcE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG)\]' logs/*.log | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}'
echo "=== date mismatch between filename and line ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,re,os
bad=0
for f in glob.glob('logs/*.log'):
    fd=os.path.basename(f)[:10]
    for line in open(f,errors='replace'):
        m=re.match(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})',line)
        if m and m.group(1)!=fd:
            bad+=1
            if bad<=10: print(f, line.strip())
print('mismatches:',bad)
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, re, os, csv
from datetime import date, timedelta
from collections import defaultdict

REF = date(2025,8,12)
ranges = {
 'today': (REF, REF),
 'last_7_days': (REF - timedelta(days=6), REF),
 'last_30_days': (REF - timedelta(days=29), REF),
 'month_to_date': (REF.replace(day=1), REF),
 'total': None,
}
sev_re = re.compile(r'\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]')
counts = {p: defaultdict(int) for p in ranges}
total = len(glob.glob('logs/*.log')); nlines=0
for f in glob.glob('logs/*.log'):
    d = date.fromisoformat(os.path.basename(f)[:10])
    for line in open(f, errors='replace'):
        m = sev_re.search(line)
        if not m: continue
        sev = m.group(1); nlines += 1
        for p,(rng) in ranges.items():
            if rng is None or rng[0] <= d <= rng[1]:
                counts[p][sev] += 1
with open('summary.csv','w',newline='') as out:
    w = csv.writer(out)
    w.writerow(['period','severity','count'])
    for p in ['today','last_7_days','last_30_days','month_to_date','total']:
        for s in ['ERROR','WARNING','INFO']:
            w.writerow([p,s,counts[p][s]])
print('files:', total, 'severity lines:', nlines)
print(open('summary.csv').read())
PY
echo "=== locations ==="
ls -l /workspace/summary.csv
ls -ld /app 2>/dev/null && cp /workspace/summary.csv /app/summary.csv && ls -l /app/summary.csv || echo "no /app dir"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
echo "08-12 only:"
grep -hoE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' logs/2025-08-12_*.log | sort | uniq -c
echo "08-06..08-12:"
for i in 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do cat logs/2025-08-$i\_*.log; done | grep -hoE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' | sort | uniq -c
echo "08-01..08-12:"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do cat logs/2025-08-$i\_*.log; done | grep -hoE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' | sort | uniq -c
echo "total:"
cat logs/*.log | grep -hoE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' | sort | uniq -c
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
for f in logs/*.log; do d=$(basename "$f" | cut -c1-10); if [[ "$d" > "2025-07-13" && "$d" < "2025-08-13" ]]; then cat "$f"; fi; done | grep -hoE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' | sort | uniq -c
echo "--- csv ---"
cat /app/summary.csv
EOF
